final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races FROM circuit_counts), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / total_races AS share FROM circuit_counts CROSS JOIN total), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT shares.circuitId, shares.race_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.avg_share AS difference FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share > average_share.avg_share ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
